milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The player must navigate near the cut_red_sandstone_slab cross structure (centered at spawn-relative 6, 1, 6) and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. max_distance=8 ensures the player has actually walked toward the structure rather than trivially satisfying it from spawn (~8.5 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining terracotta drops the terracotta block itself into the player's inventory (no silk touch required). The player starts with no terracotta in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly verifies the outcome of the mining action.
